source_artifact_refs.consumption_role: Defines fallback / incident / stability as a remaining blocker that can be addressed by reviewed schema-first design without new access.
Records candidate status-page, outage, coverage, fallback, and unresolved incident evidence from prior documentation review.
Defines drift dimensions, no silent defaults, no latest-only historical backfill, incident logging, and allowed monitor action names.
Records the approved SEC EDGAR sample success and FMP legacy endpoint errors that must remain incident evidence, not provider selection.
Records the same-scope AAPL / MSFT FMP stable endpoint access / response-shape pass that this playbook deliberately does not overread.

not_proven: The FMP stable retry did not prove provider uptime, quota stability, incident-history reliability, or status-page integration.
The FMP stable retry did not prove that fallback paths can be executed without user-approved access packets.
The SEC EDGAR sample did not prove full parser scale, price fallback capability, free-float authority, or DataHub readiness.
This playbook defines default-deny behavior only; it does not poll any provider status page or run any new endpoint call.

fallback_order.source_role: FMP stable financial statement and metric endpoints
fallback_order.allowed_use: Candidate primary source only after license, PIT, coverage, and approved sample validation are separately resolved.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Reviewed coverage, license / storage / retention, PIT observed-date, and field-missing-rate evidence.

fallback_order.allowed_use: Audit source for filing-grounded anomalies and observed-date sanity checks, not a price source or full normalized vendor.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Reviewed parser lineage for accession, accepted timestamp, units, currency, period, amendment, and restatement behavior.

fallback_order.allowed_use: Block production use or mark the field family not evaluable when both candidate source and audit source are unresolved.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Incident log and manual review disposition.

hard_block_triggers: Missing filingDate / acceptedDate or ambiguous observed-date behavior for historical use.
Latest/current endpoint semantics used as historical evidence without reviewed PIT rows.
SEC audit conflict on EGS-sensitive fields without a reviewed reconciliation rule.
Field units, currency, fiscal period, or restatement behavior cannot be reconciled.
manual_review_triggers: FMP and SEC disagree on revenue, income, shares, period, or filing identity for a required field.
A previously present required field disappears or changes type.
Provider exposes a new metric name that looks equivalent but lacks reviewed semantics.

fallback_order.allowed_use: Candidate daily price / volume / liquidity source only after adjustment semantics, coverage, and approved sample validation are separately resolved.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Reviewed price adjustment, volume, missing-session, zero-volume, halted, delisted, and corporate-action behavior.

fallback_order.allowed_use: Low-trust ad hoc price smoke check only after explicit user approval for that check; not part of official provider chain.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Separate user approval and reviewed no-secret result artifact.

fallback_order.allowed_use: Block production use when official candidate source is unavailable or semantically unreviewed.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Incident log and manual review disposition.

hard_block_triggers: Missing price, volume, date, adjustment, or currency fields for required rows.
Split / dividend behavior conflicts with required return or liquidity construction.
Zero-filled benchmark, price, or volume row appears in evidence or runner input.
Provider source changes adjusted / unadjusted semantics without reviewed decision.
manual_review_triggers: Large price jump, zero-volume anomaly, missing session, or return spike exceeds reviewed expectations.
Historical endpoint row count changes for an already reviewed symbol/date window.
Potential delisting or inactive-security behavior affects eligibility.

fallback_order.source_role: Reviewed FMP corporate-action and adjusted-price evidence
fallback_order.allowed_use: Candidate split / dividend / adjustment context only after a separate reviewed sample proves semantics.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Approved corporate-action sample packet with split, dividend, and adjusted price reconciliation.

fallback_order.allowed_use: Manual evidence note for isolated analysis; cannot silently normalize production rows.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Reviewed source refs and incident log.

fallback_order.allowed_use: Block production use when adjustment source or reconciliation is unresolved.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Incident log and manual review disposition.

hard_block_triggers: Split or dividend event changes return calculation and no reviewed reconciliation exists.
Adjusted and unadjusted prices are mixed in the same evidence window.
Corporate-action endpoint semantics are unknown or change silently.
manual_review_triggers: Corporate action occurs inside a sample or evidence holding window.
Provider price history changes after a split, dividend, symbol change, merger, or delisting.

fallback_order.source_role: FMP coverage / symbol / delisted candidate surfaces
fallback_order.allowed_use: Candidate coverage source only after approved counts prove active, inactive, delisted, CIK, exchange, and security-class behavior.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Reviewed coverage count packet and license decision.

fallback_order.allowed_use: Current-reference sanity checks only; not historical survivorship-safe security master.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Reviewed limitation note and manual reconciliation plan.

fallback_order.allowed_use: Block historical production use when listing / delisting / security-class eligibility is unresolved.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Incident log and manual review disposition.

hard_block_triggers: Historical eligibility depends on listing, delisting, exchange, ADR, SPAC, ETF, or security class not covered by reviewed evidence.
CIK / ticker mapping is missing or ambiguous for a required issuer.
Active-only source is used to construct historical universe membership.
manual_review_triggers: Ticker change, merger, delisting, inactive listing, ADR, duplicate CIK, or class-share ambiguity affects a candidate.
Coverage count changes materially between reviewed packets.

fallback_order.allowed_use: Fundamentals audit source for filing lineage and anomaly review only.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Reviewed parser lineage, fair-access behavior, and field mapping for the target audit fields.

fallback_order.allowed_use: Candidate primary fields only after separate PIT, coverage, and license review; not a fallback that overrides SEC conflicts silently.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Reviewed reconciliation rule for the specific conflict.

fallback_order.allowed_use: Mark audit not evaluable and block production use of conflicting fields.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Incident log and manual review disposition.

hard_block_triggers: SEC audit conflict affects EGS-sensitive field and no reviewed reconciliation rule exists.
Accession, accepted timestamp, fiscal period, unit, currency, or amendment lineage cannot be reconstructed.
SEC is treated as price source or exact free-float authority.
manual_review_triggers: Companyfacts tag choice is ambiguous for a required metric.
Amended filing or restatement changes the audit value.
SEC fair-access or request identity requirements are not satisfied.

fallback_order.allowed_use: Required before any official US benchmark return or issuer-level PIT GICS membership evidence is used.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Reviewed license, coverage, as-of semantics, and sample rows from the selected feed.

fallback_order.allowed_use: Methodology context only; not a historical return feed or issuer-level PIT membership table.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Clear limitation note in evidence packet.

fallback_order.allowed_use: Block benchmark or industry-normalized evidence when licensed feed / PIT membership is unresolved.
fallback_order.required_precondition: Incident log and manual review disposition.

hard_block_triggers: Benchmark return feed is unavailable, unlicensed, stale, or zero-filled.
Issuer-level GICS membership is latest-only or lacks as-of history.
Official methodology context is used as if it were a licensed data feed.
manual_review_triggers: Benchmark constituent methodology, index return type, or GICS taxonomy changes affect evidence interpretation.
Industry-normalized thresholds are requested before PIT membership evidence exists.

incident_response_matrix.trigger: Quota exhaustion, throttling, 429-like response, daily cap, or unreviewed rate-limit behavior affects required provider evidence.
Provider outage, repeated server errors, delayed availability, or unreliable status-page evidence affects required fields.
Authorization or account-scope error appears for a required endpoint family, including legacy 403-style failures.
Provider field names, types, units, endpoint path, row shape, or documented semantics change relative to reviewed evidence.
Required row, date, price, volume, statement, filing, benchmark, or coverage record is stale, missing, empty, or unexpectedly sparse.
As-of eligibility, filing observed date, accepted timestamp, latest-only status, or historical reconstruction boundary becomes ambiguous.
Split, dividend, symbol change, delisting, restatement, or adjusted-price behavior conflicts with reviewed return or factor construction.
SEC EDGAR audit source conflicts with FMP-derived fundamentals, or SEC parser lineage is insufficient for the requested audit field.

drift_monitor_bindings.trigger: Provider coverage counts, missing-field rates, active / inactive / delisted behavior, or universe filters change.
Freshness, latency, or cycle-time behavior affects required evidence or report timing.
Field names, units, row shape, endpoint paths, or field meanings drift from reviewed evidence.
Observed date, as-of eligibility, latest-only status, or restatement behavior becomes ambiguous.
Split, dividend, restatement, revised fundamentals, or adjustment behavior changes.
License scope, storage rights, quota, cost, account scope, or throttling changes.
Provider outage, retry instability, delayed data, or incident notice affects required evidence.
Outlier rate, revision rate, zero-volume anomalies, or return spikes exceed reviewed expectations.

decision_gates.required_resolution: This playbook must be converted into reviewed implementation contracts before any provider adapter, DataHub table, or runner consumes it.
License, local-storage, export, derived-report, retention, and non-display rights remain unresolved before production storage or DataHub design.
Coverage counts, PIT observed-date rows, and corporate-action adjustment samples require separate explicit approval before any endpoint calls.
A later implementation slice must define incident log schema, storage path, retention, review ownership, and replay behavior before execution.
Phase 7c must remain a separate reviewed schema-first DataHub / report / reproducibility slice after provider blockers are closed or accepted.

limitations: This playbook is schema-first design only; it performs no web research, provider contact, status-page polling, endpoint call, data fetch, paid upgrade, yfinance check, full-market download, adapter work, DataHub work, runner change, broker automation, or ship-gate claim.
Fallback order definitions do not select FMP or any other provider; they only state default-deny behavior if a later reviewed provider implementation encounters missing or drifting evidence.
Incident response definitions do not prove provider stability, status-page reliability, quota behavior, fallback execution, or production readiness.
SEC EDGAR remains an audit source for filing-grounded fundamentals; it is not a price source, strict free-float source, or broad normalized fundamentals vendor.
All field families remain blocked for production consumption until license, coverage, PIT, adjustment, audit-parser, fallback-execution, and incident-log gates are separately reviewed.
next_steps: Use this artifact as the fallback / incident / stability design owner for SR-PROVIDER-001 after the remaining-blocker plan.
Do not run provider status polling or additional endpoint calls by default; any broader data or yfinance check needs separate explicit approval and review.
The next no-access provider slice can be license / storage / retention review, or an incident-log schema contract that still performs no provider calls.
Any implementation of fallback execution, status monitoring, provider adapter, DataHub table, runner consumption, or Phase 7c remains blocked until a separate reviewed slice authorizes it.
